title.narrative: Resource and Support Hub for safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment

description.narrative: The Resource and Support Hub Programme is a UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office-funded programme that seeks to support organisations working in the international development sector to strengthen their safeguarding measures against sexual exploitation, abuse, and sexual harassment (SEAH). It has a strong focus on small local Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) in the Global South.
